title: PAR-134 simple HATCH gradient CMC read/write slice
scope: Correct R2004+ HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient stop decoding and encoding for the simple C2 true-color and C3 ACI methods.
Preserve the DXF projection distinction: C2 populates group-421 RGB; C3 populates per-stop group-63 ACI.
Keep all test DWG/DXF data generated locally at runtime and remove temporary outputs; add no committed drawing fixture.

sourceCrosswalk.normativeSource: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §§2.11 and 20.4.75, local copy
sourceCrosswalk.evidenceBoundary: Simple C2/C3 writer bytes are independently walked and the generated AC1024 output is parsed by libdxfrw to verify normalized stop values and following-entity alignment. A direct in-memory AC1018 body control verifies malformed nonzero reserved-BS/RC rejection and keeps the parser cursor/sentinel unconsumed. The reader vectors are local-writer-authored/mutated, not an independent third-party producer; AC1024 detached-string malformed bounds, named/book or other CMC methods, full gradient semantics, and external/native acceptance remain unqualified.

implementation.reader: Requires the R2004+ stop short to be zero and the RC continuation flags to be zero. C2 retains low-24-bit RGB only; C3 retains low-byte ACI only and refuses unrepresentable zero. Unsupported methods fail closed. Direct AC1018 malformed controls exercise both nonzero reserved-short and nonzero-RC refusal without advancing the publishing cursor.
implementation.writer: Uses the shared CMC writer for supported C2/C3 values. Active gradient output rejects unmapped methods, simultaneous non-default ACI/RGB, and named/book values on the unqualified DWG route.
implementation.publication: Failed active-gradient HATCH/MPOLYGON emission marks the staged DWG operation failed; non-gradient skipped-entity behavior is unchanged.
implementation.dxfProjection: Allows recognized C2/C3 DWG metadata only when it agrees with normalized stop fields; emits DXF groups 421/63 and does not map group 431.

verification.refusalControls: Unsupported method, unrepresentable C3 ACI zero, simultaneous ACI/RGB, color name, and color-book name each preserve the destination and pass a corrected same-writer retry.
